Check out these key features when shopping for a women’s football uniform

Millions of athletes struggle to find the right gear. Check out these key features to look for in a women's football uniform for comfort and performance.

Written by Stephanie Heron
Published on September 5, 2026
Comments

Share the post

Share this link via

Or copy link

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 3:09
Instaread

Key features to look for when shopping for a women’s football uniform are a fit designed for women’s movement and breathable, sweat-wicking materials. You should also check durability and match-day performance, and consider personalization, protection, and practical details.

According to the NFL, around 4.1 million youth play flag football in the US, which is an increase of over 50% since 2020. In addition, the number of young women playing on their high school teams has increased by almost 60% from 2024 to 2025. This shows that there’s a growing female interest in the sport, and there needs to be more proactivity to make them feel more comfortable.

One way to do so is to choose the right women’s football uniform, which can make all the difference in their performance. These are the key things to look for in athletic apparel.

Should You Prioritize a Fit Designed for Women’s Movement?

Women’s sportswear should provide a secure and comfortable fit without restricting movement. It’s vital to look for shirts, shorts, or kits that are designed around women’s proportions rather than simply downsized from men’s uniforms.

You should avoid anything that’s excessively tight, as it can become restrictive in key moments. On the other hand, overly loose garments can snag or shift.

Choose Breathable, Sweat-Wicking Materials

Athletic performance fit is just one part of the equation; breathability is the other. Polyester and other performance fabrics are commonly used since they’re lightweight, durable, and designed to move moisture away from the skin.

Look for shirts with breathable construction or mesh panels in areas where heat tends to build up (e.g., the sides and underarms). Quick-drying material can also prevent you from having a sweat-soaked jersey. Avoid thick fabrics that trap heat or absorb large amounts of moisture.

Check Durability and Match-Day Performance

Your football uniform needs to withstand much more than just a few games, so when you’re comparing uniforms, look at the:

  • Stitching
  • Seams
  • Fabric weight
  • Construction around high-stress areas

It’s also helpful to check the care instructions before buying. Uniforms that require unusually delicate washing may be impractical for regular team use.

If you’re buying a complete team kit, consistency matters, too. There should be reliable sizing, color retention, and durable printing.

Should You Consider Personalization, Protection, and Practical Details?

The best football uniform should suit the practical demands of the player as well as the team’s appearance. If you’re buying a team kit, check whether the names, numbers, club badges, and sponsor logos can be added as part of custom sports gear from The Imperial Point.

Another consideration is whether you need separate home and away colors, as well as different options for training. The supplier you choose should have good replacement availability as well. This will make it easier to replace damaged uniforms or accommodate new players.

Choose the Perfect Women’s Football Uniform

Having the right women’s football uniform can make all the difference in your performance on the field. By using our advice, you can compare options wisely and pick something that works for you.
